messages:
Aisha (AE): Hey team — enterprise prospect (FinCloud) has a couple of BYO-KMS asks that could block the POC. Need quick alignment so I can answer their security questionnaire and confirm pricing impact. Main asks: 1) HSM-backed CMKs only (CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM). 2) Rotation window: customer wants monthly rotation with overlap and audit of key ceremony. 3) Key wrap/unwrap latency SLA: they need <50ms median for key unwrap on sign/verify hot path. 4) Escrow: they want an offline key escrow option for disaster recovery. 5) Billing: how does BYO-KMS affect our hosted pricing vs Dedicated. Can someone own the answers and a short runbook we can send?

Marco (SE): I can take the technical pieces. Short answers up front: we support BYO-CMK via external KMS integrations (CloudKMS/CloudHSM and equivalents) + HSM-backed keys when customer provides HSM or cloud HSM. For latency: request path is an extra network hop — typical added latency 10–40ms depending on region and peering. We can run a latency POC with synthetic wrap/unwrap calls to demonstrate medians. For rotation we support rolling rotation with key aliases and dual-key overlap — we can script the ceremony.

Jules (Security): For the questionnaire, we need to confirm: a) key provenance (HSM attestation artifact or signed CSR), b) access controls (who can call unwrap), c) audit log retention and tamper evidence, d) key usage policy (sign vs decrypt). Also need confirmation of whether Redwood-managed fallback CMK is acceptable for failover (they want to avoid fallback unless explicitly approved). I'll draft the minimal answers.

Priya (SRE): Operational notes: if they use cloud HSM across a peered VPC, we recommend a dedicated low-latency path (VPC peering/privatelink) and single-digit-ms intra-region hop to hit <50ms. If peering not available expect the 20–60ms added. We need an SLO addendum: key unwraps are treated as control-plane calls for rate limiting and billing (we can expose a per-unwrap metric). We should also document retry/backoff and async fallback behavior in case of KMS transient errors.

Aisha (AE): Perfect. Customer also asked about pricing: will BYO-KMS add a surcharge? They mentioned ~5M sign ops/month in their load profile.

Marco (SE): Pricing model options: 1) Hosted + BYO: base token pricing + per-key-op surcharge (covers egress and async retries). Example estimate: at 5M key ops, surcharge ~ $0.003/key-op -> ~$15k/mo. 2) Dedicated: reserved capacity with integrated HSM (we can colocate their HSM on the Dedicated nodes) is subscription-based (committed) and reduces per-op surcharge. I'll pull a quick back-of-envelope. This is high level — ops team and finance might adjust.

Legal (Lia): Also flagging contract terms: BYO-HSM increases responsibilities (key custody SLA, incident reporting, escrow conditions). We need to confirm whether customer requires 3rd-party attestation and include specific audit-rights language.

Aisha (AE): Good call. Jules — can you draft the Qs for the security questionnaire? Marco/Priya — can you produce a 1-page runbook and a small synthetic latency test script we can run during the POC? I want to share all by EOD so the customer can schedule the POC for next week.

Jules (Security): Will do. Draft will include: 1) HSM attestation artifact request (serial + attestation cert), 2) allowed principals + JIT process, 3) log retention (90/365 options) and format (JSON/immutable), 4) rotation playbook (pre-rotate replicate, double-sign period, roll-forward + rollback steps), 5) escrow requirements and encrypted key shards.

Marco (SE): I'll attach a tiny test harness for wrap/unwrap to the thread. Example cURL for their engineers to run against their KMS endpoint (replace placeholders):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://<customer-kms-endpoint>/v1/keys/<KEYID>:encrypt" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"plaintext":"SGVsbG8=","context":{"request_id":"test-123"}}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KMS_TOKEN>"

# measure latency (ms) from client side and return timing header X-Server-Latency
```

Marco (SE): Also adding a simple synthetic we can run from Redwood's test agents to measure median. If they allow traffic mirroring we can run against prod surface for realistic numbers; otherwise run from staging.

Priya (SRE): For RM-runbook: include failover plan: 1) transient errors -> retry w/ exponential backoff (max 5s), 2) prolonged outage -> automatic failover to Redwood-managed CMK only if customer pre-authorizes (explicit opt-in), 3) incident playbook -> alert on 5xx rate > 1% and median unwrap > 200ms. I'll produce a 1-pager.

Aisha (AE): OpsBot ticket please so we have a traceable deliverable for POC.

OpsBot: New internal task created: TASK-5429 — "FinCloud BYO-KMS POC: runbook, latency harness, security Qs" assigned to Marco, Jules, Priya. Due: 3 business days.

Aisha (AE): Thanks. Quick Q — escrow: customer insists on encrypted key escrow with multi-custodian shards. Is that something we can support or will that need a custom SOW?

Jules (Security): We can support encrypted key escrow in principle. Two options: 1) Customer provides escrow key stores and we store encrypted shards (we never hold plaintext), 2) Redwood operates escrow in a vault with strict access controls and notarized access procedure. Option 1 is easiest contractually. Option 2 requires a custom SOW and legal sign-off.

Marco (SE): From an ops standpoint, option 1 is easiest: they give us a KMS endpoint for escrow sealing, or provide pre-encrypted shards to store in our object store with retention rules. We should document monitoring for escrow retrieval attempts.

Aisha (AE): Great. I'll push Option 1 as default and flag Option 2 as premium. Can you all drop your artifacts here by EOD? I'll loop in FinCloud's security lead when we have the draft.

Priya (SRE): Dropping the runbook and SLO bullets by 5pm PST.

Marco (SE): I'll post the latency harness and an initial cost sketch by 4pm PST.

Jules (Security): Questionnaire draft by 3:30pm PST.

Legal (Lia): I'll prepare a short BYO-KMS clause template for the SOW to attach — end of day.

Aisha (AE): Awesome — thanks everyone. Follow-up call scheduled with customer for Thu 10:00am PT (inv sent).

Priya (SRE): Note for the record: if they insist on monthly rotations with zero overlap window we need to disallow that for production — must have at least 24h dual-key overlap. Flagging as potential blocker.

Aisha (AE): I'll confirm with the customer. If they push zero-overlap that will be a hard no.

Marco (SE): One last thing — if they want HSM attestation, ask for the attestation format (e.g., AWS CloudHSM vs Azure attest). We need the exact artifact type to validate.

Jules (Security): Added to the questionnaire.

Aisha (AE): OK thread complete for now — thanks. I'll post the customer's security questionnaire response once we have the drafts. :pray:
